notes.title: Blender 4.5.3 LTS Maintenance Release !
notes.content:
[p]Blender 4.5.3 LTS features important bug fixes. It is released on the [i]v4.5 - Stable - LTS[/i] branch.  You can switch to this by [b]right-clicking[/b] on the [b]Blender[/b] entry in your library, select [b]Properties...[/b]. Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select [b]v4.5 - Stable - Stable[/b].  

[/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p][/p][p]

* [4.5 LTS] Fix memory leak when loading libraries fails from Python. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/0056783a60d11e9eb20d5fbe73d4535989871b02]0056783a60d11e9eb20d5fbe73d4535989871b02[/url])
* Fix: Grease Pencil: Smooth sculpt brush not working with handles and mask. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/b1b7360fc2543212c63b66be89536dacae38cce1]b1b7360fc2543212c63b66be89536dacae38cce1[/url])
* Add-on hotkey customizations are not saved for custom operators. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143838]#143838[/url])
* [4.5 LTS] Fix: frozen mathutils Vector & Matrix types could be resized. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/3bb0b4864df761bb3d2db593eea8b5a9ffa797e8]3bb0b4864df761bb3d2db593eea8b5a9ffa797e8[/url])
* Fix: UVSculpt brush size not converted correctly for 5.0 changes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/f2c538ae863025869deb9bb3201a4a9bbb32ea56]f2c538ae863025869deb9bb3201a4a9bbb32ea56[/url])
* bpy.context.object.modifiers["Lineart"].thickness no longer works in 4.5.2. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145138]#145138[/url])
* Grease pencil: Divide blend mode doesn't work. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143802]#143802[/url])
* Fix: Vulkan: Submission runner crash on start. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/baa7ba7cbee894d034a59b309923a444b1a1f52c]baa7ba7cbee894d034a59b309923a444b1a1f52c[/url])
* Vulkan: NVIDIA driver 580.76.05 on Wayland freezes at startup. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144625]#144625[/url])
* When using the Vulkan backend, material compilation errors directly lead to Blender crashing. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144614]#144614[/url])
* Blender Light Probes do not create "mirrors" in 4.5 with Vulkan enabled. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142110]#142110[/url])
* Missing display update for unified strength icon. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144281]#144281[/url])
* Crash selecting the text on a linked duplicated text object. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144970]#144970[/url])
* 4.5 Crash with Cycles render w/ Persistent Data + fileview thumbnails sequence. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143662]#143662[/url])
* Fix: Workbench: Broken render tests after AA fix. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/df9239608bbc21f23b233c65b2eba6898ada9f18]df9239608bbc21f23b233c65b2eba6898ada9f18[/url])
* Fix: Workbench: Broken render tests after AA fix. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/df9239608bbc21f23b233c65b2eba6898ada9f18]df9239608bbc21f23b233c65b2eba6898ada9f18[/url])
* Cycles: Add ROCm 7 runtime to hipew search list. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/f6c709f30b23be4fa9618938c2bb3c052a74421d]f6c709f30b23be4fa9618938c2bb3c052a74421d[/url])
* Cycles: Add support for building with CUDA 13.0 and OptiX 9.0. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/6f6bf2b64d5c8cdec7fb5927fe41eca3818be8ce]6f6bf2b64d5c8cdec7fb5927fe41eca3818be8ce[/url])
* Vulkan: Weird pink shading with temporal accumlation turned off. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144636]#144636[/url])
* Crash switching camera from Camera View to Orthographic view in Material Preview mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143857]#143857[/url])
* EEVEE: Rendering is incorrect in walk mode with overscan enabled. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144441]#144441[/url])
* Fix #144599: Cycles OSL node with external script does not update. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144808]#144808[/url])
* Invalid text selection in the Python console. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144858]#144858[/url])
* Illegal Address in CUDA queu copy_from_device (integrator_shade surface_raytrace integrator_sorted_paths_arrays_prefix_sum). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143841]#143841[/url])
* Cycles OptiX: When adjusting material properties that enables shader ray tracing, the material will momentarily render incorrectly. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144910]#144910[/url])
* Dynamic Paint: Bake Image Sequence crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143958]#143958[/url])
* OSL call for "geom:name" stopped working in Blender 4.5 LTS. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144814]#144814[/url])
* Crash when calling any node group from side properties panel. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144621]#144621[/url])
* Assert on `Add Texture Paint Slot`. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144175]#144175[/url])
* Crash when attempting to Unlink linked IDs from the Unused Data Outliner. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144840]#144840[/url])
* Dynamic Paint Crash switching displace factor from positive to negative - FYI  New light project OK. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142137]#142137[/url])
* Blender crashes when snapping after aligning in edit mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144916]#144916[/url])
* Fix: EEVEE: Memory leak when drawing Volume objects. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/f6676240896]f6676240896[/url])
* Python: Modifying Workspaces via Python and 'Reporting an Error' Crashes Blender. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144958]#144958[/url])
* Cloth simulation presets only save some of the settings. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/104074]#104074[/url])
* Force fields don't work on a fire simulation with Flame Smoke 0. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/86512]#86512[/url])
* Falling fluid simulation has odd behaviour. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144701]#144701[/url])
* Crash when scrubbing Scene Strip in Video Sequencer. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144982]#144982[/url])
* Fix: ACES 2.0 studio config sets image files to ACES2065-1 incorrectly. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/820afacf15f]820afacf15f[/url])
* crash when moving GP stroke. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143635]#143635[/url])
* UI freezes with lots of action slots (in the Outliner). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143697]#143697[/url])
* Python: Improve `bpy.data.user_map()` argument documentation. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/cc943ea8145]cc943ea8145[/url])
* WORKBENCH with MATCAPS Rendering Issues in Blender 4.5 and 5.0 Alpha. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142738]#142738[/url])
* EEVEE: Freeze playing back a certain animation on macOS. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142381]#142381[/url])
* Assert fail in Limited Dissolve of flattened cone. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144383]#144383[/url])
* gpu.state.line_width_set() Does not work in vulkan. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144700]#144700[/url])
* split selection removes vertices. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145108]#145108[/url])
* Value Node not changeable in Properties Window. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144760]#144760[/url])
* Blender 4.5.2 LTS Clay strips brush - View plane acts like area plane. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145070]#145070[/url])
* NDOF/3D mouse: Pan Zoom is reversed in cardinal-orthographic views, in fly mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144751]#144751[/url])
* Crash when converting multiple objects to grease pencil with shared mesh data. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145287]#145287[/url])
* Crash when joining (Ctrl-J) two Grease Pencil objects in Blender 4.5.2 LTS. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145297]#145297[/url])
* Crash: 4.5.1 can't open 5.0 file that contains Closure Zone. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144414]#144414[/url])
* Segmentation fault on grease_pencil_export_svg with frame_mode='SELECTED'. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145259]#145259[/url])
* Crash in Viewport Render Animation when GDB is Attached. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145375]#145375[/url])
* Fix: incorrect handling of 3x3 matrices with RNA get/set callbacks. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/c01b33593f1]c01b33593f1[/url])
* The Greace pencil stroke copying bug. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145228]#145228[/url])
* Blender 4.5 unusual slow playback speed compare to B4.4 In large scale geometry nodes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145385]#145385[/url])
* Compositor Cyclic links warning doesn't disappear. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145403]#145403[/url])
* Copy Global Transforms: SKIP_SAVE on paste. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/1459f185cb8]1459f185cb8[/url])
* FBX: new 4.5 importer places (instanced?) objects from Navisworks FBX file at origin. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145116]#145116[/url])
* Asset shelf breaks when changing preview size. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/112936]#112936[/url])
* Anim: fix crash when loading F-Curve with unknown modifier. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/5844ee62291]5844ee62291[/url])
* Fix: viewer shortcut description mentions compositor only. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/f5e6be7f398]f5e6be7f398[/url])
* 4.5.3 regression - bpy behavior change on evaluated mesh with SK. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145340]#145340[/url])
* .glb file importing problem. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144980]#144980[/url])
* Python API: GPU module compute shader local group size defaults to -1 instead of 1 on Vulkan/OpenGL. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145818]#145818[/url])
* Blender Crashes With Curve Pen Tool While Using With Nurbs Curve. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145560]#145560[/url])
* Build: resolve linking error on *BSD systems. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/0648332ceba]0648332ceba[/url])
* [Zh_CN] Driver auto-variable name "变量"causes Python error. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145590]#145590[/url])
* FBX: new importer does not import textures from some files. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145244]#145244[/url])
* Movie distortion node is more pixelated using the Auto GPU compositor. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145439]#145439[/url])
* Cryptomatte shows numeric value instead of picked asset name. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145498]#145498[/url])
* Crash on separating hair curves object. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145666]#145666[/url])
* Can't use Intel Arc A770 GPU in Blender 4.5.2 LTS despite having the latest packages installed. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145449]#145449[/url])
* Captured attribute not propagated to Set Mesh Normal. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145691]#145691[/url])
* Fix: MaterialX export can end up with duplicate node names. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/5ba56b4c6da]5ba56b4c6da[/url])
* VSE - dragging on an image sequence no longer updates the Frame number in the Preview overlay. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144332]#144332[/url])
* USDZ in Blender 4.3.0: textures missing on FBX -> USDZ export (new export_textures_mode). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145711]#145711[/url])
* Fix: 3D text line end misses last character. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/3b12157b928]3b12157b928[/url])
* Undo history Unknown Action. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144096]#144096[/url])


For a detailed list of bug fixes in each release, see [url="https://www.blender.org/download/lts/4-5/"] 4.5 LTS releases on blender.org[/url]

[/p][h3]LTS Program[/h3][p]
Learn more about the [url="https://www.blender.org/download/lts/"]LTS program on blender.org[/url]

[/p][h3]Stay up-to-date[/h3][p]
You can follow Blender on social media:

Keep reporting any issues you find to make this LTS the most stable release ever !

Happy blending,
The Blender team[/p]

notes.title: Blender 4.2.14 LTS Maintenance Release !
notes.content:
Blender 4.2.14 LTS features important bug fixes. It is released on the [i]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/i] branch.

You can switch to this by [b]right-clicking[/b] on the [b]Blender[/b] entry in your library, select [b]Properties...[/b]. Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select [b]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/b].

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]

* Dynamic Paint Crash switching displace factor from positive to negative - FYI  New light project OK. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142137]#142137[/url])
* Blender crashes when snapping after aligning in edit mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144916]#144916[/url])
* Crash when attempting to Unlink linked IDs from the Unused Data Outliner. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144840]#144840[/url])
* Python: Modifying Workspaces via Python and 'Reporting an Error' Crashes Blender. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144958]#144958[/url])
* In 4.2 Python Tooltips or data paths related to most checkboxes in Video Sequencer Preview Overlays refer to the wrong path. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/145415]#145415[/url])
* HDRi lighting does not correctly apply in EEVEE Next on older AMD GPU drivers. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124984]#124984[/url])
* Fix: Geometry Nodes: anoymous attributes are not always propagated in Trim Curve node. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/181a932fbc5]181a932fbc5[/url])
* 4.4 Crash when a specific GPU compositor setup. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/134259]#134259[/url])

[/list]

For a detailed list of bug fixes in each release, see [url=https://www.blender.org/download/lts/4-2/] 4.2 LTS releases on blender.org[/url]

[h3]LTS Program[/h3]

Learn more about the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/lts/]LTS program on blender.org[/url]

[h3]Stay up-to-date[/h3]

You can follow Blender on social media:

Keep reporting any issues you find to make this LTS the most stable release ever !

Happy blending,
The Blender team

notes.title: Blender 4.5.2 LTS Maintenance Release !
notes.content:
[p]Blender 4.5.2 LTS features important bug fixes. It is released on the [i]v4.5 - Stable - LTS[/i] branch.  You can switch to this by [b]right-clicking[/b] on the [b]Blender[/b] entry in your library, select [b]Properties...[/b]. Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select [b]v4.5 - Stable - Stable[/b].  

[/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p][/p][p]

* Cleanup `bpy` builds on PyPI and archive them on Download. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/infrastructure/meta/issues/146]#146[/url])
* Vertex/Weight Paint Mask issues with subdivision. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143317]#143317[/url])
* Regression: Shading Issue transforming a object with custom normals. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142485]#142485[/url])
* Missnamed Built-In Shader. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143485]#143485[/url])
* Asset browser capture screenshot preview does not capture Cycles rendered preview. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/141732]#141732[/url])
* USD: World uses wrong output node. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143291]#143291[/url])
* Vertex Weight Proximity sets Normalize Weights checkbox to default state after options switch. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143360]#143360[/url])
* UI: grey-out NDOF orbit center settings in "Fly mode". ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/98596c9bccc]98596c9bccc[/url])
* Fix: Grease Pencil: Remove fill guide attribute in `remove_fill_guides`. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/5c1e9125b91]5c1e9125b91[/url])
* Tool gizmo disappears when resizing regions & areas. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143629]#143629[/url])
* Pivot to Active Vertex in Mesh Sculpt mode not working. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143630]#143630[/url])
* Fix: `SculptSession#last_active_vert` uses incorrect value. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/fa3bebbbd6f]fa3bebbbd6f[/url])
* `bpy.ops.grease_pencil.join_selection(type='JOIN')` makes existing strokes broken. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142325]#142325[/url])
* Action editor with playhead snapping crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143154]#143154[/url])
* macOS complains about being unable to use Vulkan if a user reuses Vulkan user preferences. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143304]#143304[/url])
* [Clipping Region] Multi 3D Views & Alt+B enabled - click selection picks mesh outside region before target in mesh edit mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142800]#142800[/url])
* Attribute node (Type: View Layer) is not updated during playback in EEVEE when nothing is animated. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143323]#143323[/url])
* OpenGL: --debug-gpu doesn't work in background mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142620]#142620[/url])
* Field Nodes not outputing values from node groups. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142202]#142202[/url])
* Old AMD Drivers: Crashes on startup (4.4.0 and above). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143087]#143087[/url])
* Error "Selected faces required" When Using 'K' Knife Cut After Confirming Previous Cut with 'Shift+K' in Edit Mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143439]#143439[/url])
* Hydra Storm: Error in console when rendering. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143722]#143722[/url])
* Fix: Nodes: restore active node after copy-pasting nodes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/0a37bba5a99]0a37bba5a99[/url])
* Dot dash modifier makes grease pencil disappear. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143870]#143870[/url])
* Solidify Algorithm Behaves Strange/Different in 4.5. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143789]#143789[/url])
* Vulkan: Assert when sliding vertex. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143685]#143685[/url])
* Blender displays a crash popup when OSL camera references oso file that doesn't exist. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143907]#143907[/url])
* Fix: Cycles: Show correct minimum OptiX GPU driver in preferences. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/c1c735dd5a0]c1c735dd5a0[/url])
* Repeated deletion & Ctrl+Z on a linked library may cause crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143888]#143888[/url])
* Broken Normals when realizing Instances with Geometry Nodes that have an Object with WeightedNormal Modifier (and mirrored). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143708]#143708[/url])
* Regression: Crash in Vertex & Weight Paint when applying deform modifier. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143238]#143238[/url])
* Fix: Poll function for asset screenshot operator. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/7a1ad217c69]7a1ad217c69[/url])
* Intel Arc OpenGL: GPU compositor infill is inconsistent. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/141173]#141173[/url])
* Volume shader masked by shader with alpha blend transparency. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143294]#143294[/url])
* NVIDIA Vulkan: Blender 4.5 crash on startup with MSI Afterburner/RivaTuner Statistic Server. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/141806]#141806[/url])
* Fix: VSE: Wrong context used when dropping audio files. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/d648f124756]d648f124756[/url])
* Cryptomatte: Precision issues with matte output. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143775]#143775[/url])
* Bevel & Join Geometry crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143450]#143450[/url])
* Viewport: Blender crashes when entering sculpting mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142093]#142093[/url])
* Problem with edit lines display on grease pencil object. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143952]#143952[/url])
* 4.5 LTS: Fix: armature "Auto-Name by Axis" creating invalid UTF8 names. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/b670fad9cb33cb5c0b375826fc684312ab4a844b]b670fad9cb33cb5c0b375826fc684312ab4a844b[/url])
* Cleanup: No longer require VSE Strip struct memory layout to never change [4.5]. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/c4c612ba5337f19f2cbe7eb4854a2babdbce1e65]c4c612ba5337f19f2cbe7eb4854a2babdbce1e65[/url])
* Intel Windows OpenGL: Dilate node feather mode does not work. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/141436]#141436[/url])
* Curves in EDIT mode appear thinner than in OBJECT mode on HiDPi displays. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/141980]#141980[/url])
* Vertex Paint: Subtract blending mode is broken. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143399]#143399[/url])
* Regression: Frustum culling is incorrect in Blender 4.5 with older AMD GPU drivers. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143336]#143336[/url])
* Transparent background is not fully transparent in Workbench Render Engine. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144040]#144040[/url])

notes.title: Blender 4.2.13 LTS Maintenance Release !
notes.content:
Blender 4.2.13 LTS features important bug fixes. It is released on the [i]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/i] branch.

You can switch to this by [b]right-clicking[/b] on the [b]Blender[/b] entry in your library, select [b]Properties...[/b]. Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select [b]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/b].

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]

* OpenVDB cache Mantaflow Gas has Hollow Emission. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/91174]#91174[/url])
* Cycles Render: Volume (Before Baked Simulation Starts) still trying to be rendered. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/105546]#105546[/url])
* 4.2 backport: Fix: crash displaying negative numbers in WM_cursor_time. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/cf4c65d8d6e65579777c3e0ab6db0fb422332ade]cf4c65d8d6e65579777c3e0ab6db0fb422332ade[/url])
* Fix: Only last tangents layer is exported to fbx when mesh has multiple uv layers. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/b40856b76d7]b40856b76d7[/url])
* Crash adding subsurf with invalid material indices. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/142245]#142245[/url])
* Crash selecting an armature with over 65k objects. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143161]#143161[/url])
* Cleanup `bpy` builds on PyPI and archive them on Download. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/infrastructure/meta/issues/146]#146[/url])
* Ctrl + H "Hide Other Collections" Pie Menu – Shift to Extend Not Working. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/140548]#140548[/url])
* Vertex Weight Proximity sets Normalize Weights checkbox to default state after options switch. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/143360]#143360[/url])
* Nuked my C: drive accidentally using Blender. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/139585]#139585[/url])
* Dyntopo detail size drawing with Shift + D seems broken. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/83623]#83623[/url])
* Removing and then redefining override causes a crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144373]#144373[/url])
* Fix: execute_node_group only accepting positive values for arguments. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/26d3ea18beb]26d3ea18beb[/url])
* Blender crashes opening certain file. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/144749]#144749[/url])
* Regression: ASAN `heap-use-after-free` crash when pasting node group after undoing or opening a new file. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/141415]#141415[/url])


[/list]

For a detailed list of bug fixes in each release, see [url=https://www.blender.org/download/lts/4-2/] 4.2 LTS releases on blender.org[/url]

[h3]LTS Program[/h3]

Learn more about the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/lts/]LTS program on blender.org[/url]

[h3]Stay up-to-date[/h3]

You can follow Blender on social media:

Keep reporting any issues you find to make this LTS the most stable release ever !

Happy blending,
The Blender team

notes.title: Blender 4.4 Released
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developer community proudly present Blender 4.4!

Featuring artwork from Flow, the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FlT1t1uTPaU]Oscar-winning[/url] film entirely made in Blender. Read the [url=https://www.blender.org/user-stories/making-flow-an-interview-with-director-gints-zilbalodis/]user story with director Gints Zilbalodis[/url].

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

Blender 4.4 focuses on stability, with over 700 issues tackled through the “Winter of Quality”. Read more [url=https://code.blender.org/2025/02/winter-of-quality-2025/]on the Code blog[/url].

Major improvements include a new way to pack multiple data-block animations into one Action using Slots, a full CPU rewrite for the Compositor, Grease Pencil stabilization and feature parity, Video Sequencer text editing improvements, and, as always, better performance and a more refined user interface to enhance the user experience.

Watch the video summary on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-eqPs-boihU]Blender’s YouTube channel[/url].

This work is made possible thanks to the outstanding contributions of the Blender community, and the support of the over 7300 individuals and 35 organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
March 18th, 2025

notes.title: Blender 4.3 Released
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 4.3!

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

Blender 4.3 builds on the feature-packed 4.2 LTS with improvements to existing tools, performance enhancements, and the foundations that will shape the years to come.

[url=https://fund.blender.org/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8564989/ba55264d00c6547a52bac79854683a6e7d638322.png[/img][/url]

Some highlights:

[list]
[*] [b]EEVEE: Light & Shadow Linking[/b]
[*] [b]Rendering[/b]: Metallic BSDF, and new [b]Gabor[/b] Noise texture.
[*] [b]Compositor[/b]: Support for [b]EEVEE passes[/b], new White Point Color Balance, and more.
[*] [b]Grease Pencil[/b]: Complete rewrite to support [b]Layer Groups, Geometry Nodes[/b], better erase tool, gradients, and much more.
[*] [b]Geometry Nodes[/b]: For Each Zone, Gizmos, Bakes can be packed now, new nodes and UI improvements.
[*] [b]Sculpt[/b]: Major refactor under the hood to improve performance.
[*] [b]UV[/b]: New “[b]Minimum Stretch[/b]” (SLIM) unwrapping method.
[*] [b]Modeling[/b]: Bevel modifier can now use custom attributes.
[*] [b]Brush Assets[/b]: All brushes are now assets, to be shared easily between projects.
[*] [b]USD[/b]: Support for exporting Point Clouds.
[*] [b]glTF[/b]: Draco mesh compression for importing, better export of UDIM tiles, quaternions and matrix attributes. Plus loads of bug fixes.
[*] And so much more!
[/list]

Watch the video summary on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KnpvIIfm7uQ]Blender’s YouTube channel[/url].

And many more features and fixes await you—explore the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/4-3/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new!

This work is made possible thanks to the outstanding contributions of the Blender community, and the support of the over 4800 individuals and 35 organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
November 19th, 2024

Blender 4.2.4 LTS features important bug fixes. It is released on the [i]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/i] branch.

You can switch to this by [b]right-clicking[/b] on the [b]Blender[/b] entry in your library, select [b]Properties...[/b]. Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select [b]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/b].

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]

* Grease pencil stroke direction overlay missing on 4.3 (GPv3) and on Mac 4.2. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128079]#128079[/url])
* Fix 'missing files' operator not reporting which ID is using the missing filepath. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/1b3198999ed77b]1b3198999ed77b[/url])
* Blender freezes permanently when pausing animation with multiframe on - macOS?. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129183]#129183[/url])
* 4.2 LTS: Intel GPU Compositor Lens Distortion node produces blank result. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129719]#129719[/url])
* Sculpt Mode: Confirming gesture tool creates additional gesture point. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127557]#127557[/url])
* Crash when active attribute is none. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127691]#127691[/url])
* Opening Blender 3 document in Blender 4 breaks Alpha transparency in Cycles. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126562]#126562[/url])
* Edge Slide freezes blender and mouse cursor movement if geometry is too broken. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128702]#128702[/url])
* Crash when dragging a file into Blender with Wayland. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128766]#128766[/url])
* Precision mode does not work with grid snap. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/122635]#122635[/url])
* New Snap To Grid snaps to "floor"/"visible" 2-dimensional grid only (4.1 was a 3-dimensional grid). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126665]#126665[/url])
* Regression: Eevee Not rendering textures when displacement is used. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128282]#128282[/url])
* Extensions build: no error handling when "type" is missing. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128840]#128840[/url])
* Skipping wheel for other system (macosx_10_9_universal2 != macosx_11.2_arm64). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128838]#128838[/url])
* Grease Pencil is shown in front when deactivating "Show Overlays". ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128813]#128813[/url])
* Spotlights with Shadows Cast Strange Artifacts in Eevee Next (4.2 RC). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124636]#124636[/url])
* When using the biset tool, and using cntl to snap to angle intervals, it seems it doesn't snap to exactly 45 degrees. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128637]#128637[/url])
* Regression: Icons don't display on custom nodes anymore. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128982]#128982[/url])
* "Sync Visible Range" option not working in "Movie Clip Editor Panel" > Tracking Mode > View - Graph. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126728]#126728[/url])
* Animation doesn't play/start when cursor is over side panel of NLA editor. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126869]#126869[/url])
* NLA Editor's Channel list does not update when object's viewport visibility changes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127117]#127117[/url])
* Armature Unselectable EditBones are not selectable from Outliner, assert in debug builds. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127180]#127180[/url])
* Missing brush visualization when using Shift to smooth. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127399]#127399[/url])
* Blendfile corruption when loading a local Image which is already loaded through linked data. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/130194]#130194[/url])
* Face Set From Masked Not Working in Blender 4.2.2. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129085]#129085[/url])
* Shadow breaks with linked duplicate. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128085]#128085[/url])
* Overlay: Apply scale on lights is showing wrong size of light. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128916]#128916[/url])
* Crash when using Subdivision Modifier and Armature Modifier on a skinned mesh(v4.2.3LTS). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129067]#129067[/url])
* removing f-curve modifier does not purge modifier motion. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128805]#128805[/url])
* Bone Duplicate/Symmetrize doesn't affect pose bone colors. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/125451]#125451[/url])
* Broken `WITH_UI_TESTS` in Ghost Wayland builds (Wayland/Weston issues?). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129095]#129095[/url])
* Cleanup: remove deprecated typing built-ins for extension logic. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/81546f30aae]81546f30aae[/url])
* Armature bones with Selectability disabled prevent click selection through them. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/123963]#123963[/url])
* Index of nearest node evaultes GroupID input incorrectly. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128997]#128997[/url])
* selecting Cryptomate while rendering causes crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129205]#129205[/url])
* fix search string in a endless loop. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129167]#129167[/url])
* Blender can deadlock if `Operator.poll_message_set` was called with a string. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129302]#129302[/url])
* Blender unstable/crashing if command line "--python" script contains "import multiprocessing". ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127097]#127097[/url])
* bpy data `remove` performance issues. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129323]#129323[/url])
* Disabling / uninstalling extensions doesn't always remove the extension's dependencies. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/125958]#125958[/url])
* Fix memory leak pasting images in Wayland. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/1d5f3a5674e]1d5f3a5674e[/url])
* Blender 4.2.3 crashes during BMesh garbage collection. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129401]#129401[/url])
* Fix missing lock in GHOST_SystemWayland::hasClipboardImage. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/b6cb3ebb14f]b6cb3ebb14f[/url])
* Cycles Light Tree: Artifact on the principled volume shader when sun angle is "0". ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129420]#129420[/url])
* Blender 4.2.3 Sculpt Mode | "Error : EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION" | Voxel Remeshing Causes Crash Randomly But Often. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129425]#129425[/url])
* Fix: Anchored, Line, Drag Dot stroke types do not support pen flip mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/aa14409edf0]aa14409edf0[/url])
* GLTF ignores Shapekeys even if only Armature Modifier exists. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129548]#129548[/url])
* glTF exporter: Manage alpha when performing RGB2BW conversion. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/da3bbc70187]da3bbc70187[/url])
* glTF exporter: fix typo in hook name. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/188e430ed98]188e430ed98[/url])
* Python app using bpy to render via Cycles runs successfully but always has an exit status code of 139 (sometimes 245). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126807]#126807[/url])
* glTF exporter: Fix regression exporting emission with texture. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/925bcbd584b]925bcbd584b[/url])
* Exporting glb file with full backing, and a step different than 1, crashes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129407]#129407[/url])
* glTF exporter: Fix some UDIM export. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/5e116c94921]5e116c94921[/url])
* glTF exporter: Fix regression exporting animated camera. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/0d3eaf4139c]0d3eaf4139c[/url])
* Regression: Copy operation fails in nodes editor when mouse is over header. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127434]#127434[/url])
* Changing a curve's material, using 3D curves, on OptiX, in viewport rendering, results in error. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124200]#124200[/url])
* Fix: UI previews don't refresh outside of properties editor. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/3c4ebca50a8]3c4ebca50a8[/url])
* Build: Add Epoxy to OpenSubdiv library build dependencies. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/abacb185622]abacb185622[/url])
* EEVEE: Volume probe create bad shading if resolution is divisible by 3. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127215]#127215[/url])
* GPU: Avoid assert caused by overlapping attribute in material shaders. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/5e0b5190352]5e0b5190352[/url])
* Python template_list cursor is offset by 1 character. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128875]#128875[/url])
* Blender 4.2 MacOS Eevee use absurd amount of memory when render the same file compare to 4.1. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126364]#126364[/url])
* macOS: Crash when dragging window from one screen to another. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128712]#128712[/url])
* Cleanup: replace typing.Union/Option with logical OR for extensions. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/60f3e274fe3]60f3e274fe3[/url])
* Cleanup: remove deprecated typing use for extensions utility. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/eccdf1d644a]eccdf1d644a[/url])
* Blender crashes when using context.temp_override with bpy.ops.object.mode_set in some cases. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129578]#129578[/url])
* Fix memory leak on exit for bpy.app.translations members. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/720f4466c03]720f4466c03[/url])
* Fix potential out of bounds read in UTF8 string length calculation. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/86de85c0a66]86de85c0a66[/url])
* Fix memory leak with PyConfig initialization. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e928464a59a]e928464a59a[/url])
* Skipping wheel for other system (macosx_10_9_universal2 != macosx_11.2_arm64). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128838]#128838[/url])
* UI: replace "Extension" with "Add-on" for enable/disable operators. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/cd66c2dcf35]cd66c2dcf35[/url])
* Fix crash framing the camera to geometry in mesh edit-mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/26cf94dd427]26cf94dd427[/url])
* Fix crash accessing WM capabilities in background mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e9e1721c9e5]e9e1721c9e5[/url])
* Fix crash calling vertex slide without an active region. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/2e137dd561b]2e137dd561b[/url])
* Fix crash calling UV picking actions without an active region. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/eed8db420b5]eed8db420b5[/url])
* Fix memory leak in "External File Operation" on non WIN32 systems. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/ec8ed748e28]ec8ed748e28[/url])
* glTF export: Add logging level control for export. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e7d28fc6f27]e7d28fc6f27[/url])
* Blender spams verbose info on stderr. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128807]#128807[/url])
* Fix memory leak in edit-font toggle style. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e9f89f9af59385449a5d34c8d0b77bceca9f3cd6]e9f89f9af59385449a5d34c8d0b77bceca9f3cd6[/url])
* Fix "Rotate Edges" iterating over freed edges. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/da1cd9df11]da1cd9df11[/url])
* Fix "Apply Modifier as Shape" ignoring Alt to apply to selected. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/ad10bc3e05]ad10bc3e05[/url])
* Fix memory leak in mathutils.geometry.box_pack_2d. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e6b073b29e]e6b073b29e[/url])
* Fix BMeshElemSeq.sort(key=None) argument. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/86aabbbace]86aabbbace[/url])
* Armature "Assign to Collection" crashes when called with default arguments. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129607]#129607[/url])
* Extensions: exclude "wheels" from the static JSON package listing. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/02f36817d5]02f36817d5[/url])
* Extensions: support for filtering based on Python versions. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/cfc10b0232]cfc10b0232[/url])
* Armature "Assign to Collection" crashes when called with default arguments. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129607]#129607[/url])
* Extensions: quote paths in error messages, improve missing file error. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/b6f9d12510]b6f9d12510[/url])
* Tests: add tests to ensure literal paths are properly handled. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/fa4688451a]fa4688451a[/url])
* Fix missing wheel refresh after updating extensions. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/a2e69961f2]a2e69961f2[/url])
* Fix missing extensions refresh after the repository config changed. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/567c061aaf]567c061aaf[/url])
* Calling addon_utils.enable(..) fails on extensions with wheels. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/130024]#130024[/url])
* Crash when switching from EEVEE to Cycles while rendering animation. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129019]#129019[/url])
* Add cube tool grid snapping will not work on top of other objects. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/130078]#130078[/url])
* Regression: 'Sequence Render Animation' not working for scene strips in render shading. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127479]#127479[/url])
* Fix: VSE: Use after free in retiming. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/aa1d606984]aa1d606984[/url])
* Fix: VSE: use after free in for loop. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/6d3e384025]6d3e384025[/url])
* Rigify UI bug on selected bone in pose mode (Rigify type submenu). ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/130059]#130059[/url])
* Crash: Compositing with Double Edge Mask. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/130134]#130134[/url])
* Viewport Shading, Render mode, render crashes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/129235]#129235[/url])
* Grease Pencil geometry type listed in some Geometry Nodes tooltips. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128220]#128220[/url])

[/list]

For a detailed list of bug fixes in each release, see [url=https://www.blender.org/download/lts/4-2/] 4.2 LTS releases on blender.org[/url]

[h3]LTS Program[/h3]

Learn more about the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/lts/]LTS program on blender.org[/url]

[h3]Stay up-to-date[/h3]

You can follow Blender on social media:

Keep reporting any issues you find to make this LTS the most stable release ever !

Happy blending,
The Blender team

notes.title: Blender 4.2.3 LTS Maintenance Release !
notes.content:
Blender 4.2.3 LTS features important bug fixes. It is released on the [i]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/i] branch.

You can switch to this by [b]right-clicking[/b] on the [b]Blender[/b] entry in your library, select [b]Properties...[/b]. Open the [b]Betas[/b] tab and select [b]v4.2 - Stable - LTS[/b].

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
* HDRI Screen tearing. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127590]#127590[/url])
* EEVEE Next - Refractive materials do not refract emissive materials. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126455]#126455[/url])
* "Auto-Save Preferences" does not work in all preference menus. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127678]#127678[/url])
* Regression: Multires Unsubdivide destroys the vertex groups. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/93911]#93911[/url])
* Fix crash making objects single user. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/3e582bf531e]3e582bf531e[/url])
* Fix crash applying object transform for multi-user objects. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/70bac72b003]70bac72b003[/url])
* Changing enum props in redo menu doesn't update the menu drawing. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126521]#126521[/url])
* Combining two Shader to RGB nodes destroys the Normals AOV. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124567]#124567[/url])
* macOS: Splash Screen notice to about reduced performance on Rosetta. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/656fc04478c]656fc04478c[/url])
* EEVEE-NEXT: Inconsistent DOF Preview. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124514]#124514[/url])
* EEVEE-NEXT: Inconsistent DOF Preview. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124514]#124514[/url])
* Parent to triangle changes child location. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127803]#127803[/url])
* Regression: STL importing files in with smooth shaded faces. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127932]#127932[/url])
* Crash on load after id_properties_ui type change. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127952]#127952[/url])
* Fix IDPropertyUIManager.as_dict() non-array default for arrays. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/4d95b2b69cd]4d95b2b69cd[/url])
* Snapping related performance regression in 4.2. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/125646]#125646[/url])
* Snapping related performance regression in 4.2. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/125646]#125646[/url])
* Snapping related performance regression in 4.2. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/125646]#125646[/url])
* Uncheck "Load UI" causes failure in direct manipulation of nodes with certain files. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128012]#128012[/url])
* Keys deleting when moving key(s) in Graph Editor with shared animation across multiple objects. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127758]#127758[/url])
* Outdated HDRi license file. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128095]#128095[/url])
* UV islands display issue - macOS Metal. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126542]#126542[/url])
* Eevee Next: Mesh Plane Disappears on Some Angles. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127774]#127774[/url])
* Eevee Next: Mesh Plane Disappears on Some Angles. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127774]#127774[/url])
* DRW: Rename draw_debug_info.hh to avoid conflict with main branch. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/c68bd4b16f9]c68bd4b16f9[/url])
* Fix: Snap to Grid with constraint limited to floor level. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e19916d82cc]e19916d82cc[/url])
* Snaping in solid mode (Xray 1.0) doesnt snap other geometry. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128074]#128074[/url])
* 4.1 splash screen won't render in Blender 4.2.1 with MetalRT. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127622]#127622[/url])
* glTF exporter: fix crash using full collection hierarchy export. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/7389b08a08c]7389b08a08c[/url])
* Fix: Uninitialized variable in versioning code. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/0b33f52c8ca]0b33f52c8ca[/url])
* crash to desktop when baking texture from selected mesh with no faces to active. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/127964]#127964[/url])
* Fix: 'Snap to Grid' defaults to 'Center' instead of 'Median' when 'Closest' is selected. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/4447c64bbc2]4447c64bbc2[/url])
* Memory leak selecting meshes in multi-object edit-mode. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128226]#128226[/url])
* Cryptomatte segmentation error. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128315]#128315[/url])
* Incorrectly displays texture transparency when face orientation is enabled. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128113]#128113[/url])

* WIN32: Extension update failed and removed the addon instead. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/128175]#128175[/url])
* Large VDB files crashing Blender 4.2 RC - macOS Metal. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/124720]#124720[/url])
* GPU compositor glare node does not work properly on high resolution images. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/126998]#126998[/url])
* Fix: EEVEE: Volume Lightprobe: Division by zero if no object is visible. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/8a8ecabecd4]8a8ecabecd4[/url])
* Fix ARRAY_HAS_ITEM macro on 64bit systems. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/c0f0a451cd4]c0f0a451cd4[/url])
* Fix crash deleting mask vertices. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/8146e75140f]8146e75140f[/url])
* Fix mask duplicate failing to set the active point. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/eb36fbe0889]eb36fbe0889[/url])

notes.title: Blender 4.2 LTS Released
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 4.2 LTS!

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

As usual with LTS (long-term support) releases, Blender 4.2 LTS comes packed with features, improvements, and fixes ready to power your projects for the next two years.

Some highlights:

[list]
[*] New render engine: EEVEE got a complete rewrite, bringing global illumination, displacement, better SSS, volumetric lighting and shadows, viewport motion blur, and so much more.
[*] Cycles: Ray Portals, Thin Film Interference, better volume rendering, blue noise, and more.
[*] The Compositor: Can now utilize GPU acceleration for offline renders, it’s faster on CPU, and more nodes are supported in the 3D Viewport.
[*] Extensions: A new way to share, install, and update add-ons and themes online within Blender.
[*] Portable installation.
[*] Khronos PBR Neutral Tone Mapper.
[*] New sculpt tools.
[*] Video Sequencer: Strips redesign, including highlighting missing media, text strip enhancements, and better performance.
[*] Collection exporters.
[*] USD, Alembic, glTF, OBJ, PLY, and STL enhancements.
[*] Undo up to 5x faster.
[*]  Animation editors and tools upgrades.
[*]  And so much more!
[/list]

This also marks the launch of the online [url=https://extensions.blender.org/]Extensions Platform[/url] – a community website to share free and open source add-ons and themes.

Watch the video summary on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iwpBgtKilvw]Blender’s YouTube channel[/url].

And many more features and fixes await you—explore the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/4-2/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new!

This work is made possible thanks to the outstanding contributions of the Blender community, and the support of the over 4400 individuals and 38 organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
July 16th, 2024

notes.title: Blender 4.1 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 4.1!

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

After the massive leap that was 4.0, Blender 4.1 is a solid upgrade to those looking for performance, stability, and quality of life improvements all across the board.

To highlight a few:

[list]
[*] OpenImageDenoise now runs on GPU on supported hardware.
[*] Cycles rendering on Linux is 5% faster.
[*] All nodes in the Compositor now work in the Viewport (except Render Layer passes)
[*] Compositor precision and improvements to Kuwahara and Pixelate nodes.
[*] Bone Collections are now hierarchical.
[*] New animation keying workflow.
[*] Several improvements to Graph Editor and NLA including baking channels.
[*] Video Sequencer drawing, rendering, effects, and scopes are much faster.
[*] USD export of armatures and shape keys as USD skeletons and blend shapes.
[*] Several user interface improvements.
[*] Python upgraded to version 3.11
[*] Blender 4.1 is aligned with the [url=https://vfxplatform.com/]VFX Reference Platform 2024[/url].
[*]  A new Bake node in Geometry Nodes.
[/list]

Watch the video summary at [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PmIbMx_RM6k]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PmIbMx_RM6k[/url]

Plus so many more features and fixes, explore the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/4-1/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new!
Thank you!

This work is made possible thanks to the outstanding contributions of the Blender community, and the support of the over 4800 individuals and 36 organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
March 26th, 2024

notes.title: Blender 4.0 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 4.0!

[h1]Whats New[/h1]

Blender 4.0 is the first step towards a new iteration of Blender, and delivers a number of new feature and workflow improvements across all areas.

To highlight a few:

- New Principled BSDF shader
- AgX view transform for improved color handling
- Light linking in Cycles
- Node Tools, powered by Geometry Nodes
- Repeat zones in Geometry Nodes
- New Snap Base for improved placement and transform workflows
- “Type to search” and various UI improvements, including a new default font
- New animation curve editing operators
- Bone collections
- and so, so much more

notes.content:

* Fix: crash in liboverride hierarchy ensure. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/e6b99c15dbaf5]e6b99c15dbaf5[/url])
* Fix (unreported) liboverride: Hierarchy corruption when making some override local. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/c80b45f646289]c80b45f646289[/url])
* Rigify: fix unreliable interpolation of limb tweak roll. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender-addons/commit/bf936d59]bf936d59[/url])
* glTF importer: Fix custom attribute import. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender-addons/commit/8a4a56ea]8a4a56ea[/url])

* Line Art doesn't render from Sequencer Perspective. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/100596]#100596[/url])
* Clear and Keep Transformation not working when keyed. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/97628]#97628[/url])
* Fix #93685: Allow Outliner Drag to Other Windows. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/105196]#105196[/url])
* Fix memory leak when the explode modifier is used with vertex groups. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/30eb74ca48d]30eb74ca48d[/url])
* Regression: Artifacts after importing fbx file. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/109599]#109599[/url])
* PLY export: Export broken result when mesh has faces with >255 vertices. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/112011]#112011[/url])
* Importing old theme crashes Blender on "Load X.X Settings". ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/113002]#113002[/url])
* Start getting Blender default Font in Text rendering after long use. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/113044]#113044[/url])
* Python: support the step and precision arguments in rna_idprop_ui_create. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/74821371676]74821371676[/url])
* Assertion fails when parenting a library override to a bone. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/112548]#112548[/url])
* OSL CheckBox socket not working in NodeGroup. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/106760]#106760[/url])
* Fix (unreported) crash in 'startup.blend' GP default update code. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/b2c0e49bf3a]b2c0e49bf3a[/url])
* Edit Mode: Memory Leak for Separate By Loose Parts. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/113387]#113387[/url])
* 3.6 LTS: Fix text editor auto-close potentially auto-closing non-brackets. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/8b5d0ba19f9ac14f5c68da6f7d2b7fc14b95b13e]8b5d0ba19f9ac14f5c68da6f7d2b7fc14b95b13e[/url])
* 3.6 LTS: Fix crash converting spaces to tabs. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/commit/1f09031dc79a2fa2c334b95b321d804eadfab6dd]1f09031dc79a2fa2c334b95b321d804eadfab6dd[/url])
* Regression: Geometry Nodes: Merge by Distance node crashes. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/112909]#112909[/url])
* Bevel + Weld modifer Crash. ([url=https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/issues/112922]#112922[/url])

notes.title: Blender 3.6 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 3.6 LTS!

[h1]Whats New[/h1]

Blender 3.6 LTS is the last release before the major jump into the 4.x series, with focus on stability to make sure this a great release to hold on to for the next couple of years.

Nonetheless, this release brings a huge range of new features and performance improvements:

- [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-6/#simulation]Simulation Nodes[/url], the next leap in Geometry Nodes
- A new [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-6/#uv]UV packing engine[/url]
- [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-6/#animation]Animation[/url] improvements
- Faster [url=https://wiki.blender.org/wiki/Reference/Release_Notes/3.6/Pipeline_Assets_IO#FBX]FBX I/O[/url]
- Several [url=https://wiki.blender.org/wiki/Reference/Release_Notes/3.6/Pipeline_Assets_IO#USD]USD improvements[/url] including Curves/hair export
- [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-6/#cycles]Cycles speed-up[/url] on AMD, Intel® Arc™, and Apple Silicon GPUs
- Mesh editing and Geometry Nodes performance improvements
- Major updates to [url=https://wiki.blender.org/wiki/Reference/Release_Notes/3.6/Core#Library_Overrides]Library Overrides resyncing[/url]
- [url=https://wiki.blender.org/wiki/Reference/Release_Notes/3.6/User_Interface#User_Interface]User Interface[/url] improvements
- [url=https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/3.6/addons/baking/vdm_brush_baker.html]VDM Brush Baker[/url] add-on included
- and so, so much more

notes.title: Blender 3.5 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 3.5!

[h1]Whats New[/h1]

Blender 3.5 is feature packed, touching almost every corner to make Blender better in every way:

[url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-5/#viewport]GPU accelerated viewport compositor[/url]
[url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-5/#sculpt]Support for sculpting with Vector Displacement Maps (VDM) textures[/url]
[url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-5/#hair]26 built-in node groups assets for Hair grooming[/url]
[url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-5/#cycles]Faster rendering of scenes with many lights in Cycles[/url]
[url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-5/#usd]Import and export USDZ[/url]

Plus: EEVEE renders much faster on Apple Silicon devices, Cycles supports non-uniform spot lights and less noisy area lights, new animation curves tools, new UV and modeling tools, faster OBJ export, as always hundreds of bug fixes, performance, memory improvements, cleanups, refactors, and so much more.

Explore the [url=https://wiki.blender.org/wiki/Reference/Release_Notes/3.5]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new.

Thank you!
Another exciting milestone achieved thanks to the Blender community and the over 3000 individuals and organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
March 29th, 2023

notes.title: Blender 3.4 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 3.4!

[h1]Whats New[/h1]

A highlight in this release is the integration of Intel’s Open Path Guiding Library, adding support for path guiding in CPU in Cycles.

The auto-masking tools in Sculpt/Paint mode are now accessible from the 3D Viewport, and support cavity, view, and area-based auto-masking. The UV editor received several updates to existing tools as well as new operators to align UV rotation, randomize islands, support for non-uniform grid, and more.

Geometry Nodes now shows an overlay in the 3D Viewport, making it easy to debug and test parts of your node tree. Many new nodes have been added to retrieve mesh and curve data, sample UV surface, Node Group assets now show in the Add menu, and so much more.

Other improvements include a new Grease Pencil outline modifier and better Fill tool, support for PBR extensions in .mtl files, animation editors improvements, major performance speed-ups and much more.

Explore the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-4/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new.

Another exciting milestone achieved thanks to the Blender community and the over 3000 individuals and organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
December 7th, 2022

notes.title: Blender 3.3 LTS Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present the first long-term release of the 3.x series, Blender 3.3 LTS!

[h1]What's New[/h1]

A highlight in this release is the introduction of a completely new system for hair grooming, using a new Curves object type that supports Sculpt mode and the flexibility of Geometry Nodes. The particle-based system is still available and hair can be converted between systems.

Geometry Nodes has been expanded to support procedural UV Unwrapping, shortest-path nodes, and a number of new primitives and utility nodes.

Grease Pencil Line Art is more performant, and can calculate light and shadow contour lines, specify object priority, and received improvements to silhouette detection. Grease Pencil keyframes are now displayed in the general Dopesheet Editor view, making it convenient to animate regular objects and properties together with Grease Pencil keyframes.

Other improvements include better Library Overrides management, new features in Video Sequencer, modeling, UV, faster sculpting in EEVEE, updates in user interface, Cycles support for AMD Vega graphics cards and the new Intel® Arc™ GPUs, and so much more.

Explore the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-3/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new.

[h1]Built to Last[/h1]

Blender 3.3 LTS is a long-term support release, receiving fixes until September 2024.

Another exciting milestone achieved thanks to the Blender community and the over 2900 individuals and organizations contributing to the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url].

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
September 7th, 2022

notes.title: Blender 3.2 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 3.2!

[previewyoutube=TnX4_BcFY54;full][/previewyoutube]

New features and improvements include:

* Cycles: Light Groups
* Cycles: Shadow Caustics
* Cycles: Volume Motion Blur
* Support for Collections in the Asset Browser
* New Curve Pen Tool
* New Paint Tool in Sculpt Mode
* Vertex Colors refactored into generic Color Attributes
* New Duplicate Elements node in Geometry Nodes
* New Envelope Modifier in Grease Pencil
* Enhanced Channels in Video Sequencer Editor
* Animation & Rigging improvements

EEVEE shaders improvements, support for WebP image format, new experimental OBJ importer, VR, user interface and usability improvements, better multi-threading, node tree evaluation and reduced memory usage in Geometry Nodes, better performance and as always hundreds of bug fixes all across the board.

Explore the [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-2/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new.

Blender wouldn’t be possible without its amazing community, and thanks to the over 2900 individuals and organizations contributing to the Blender Development Fund.

Happy Blending! 

The Blender Team
June 8th, 2022

notes.title: Blender 3.1 Released!
notes.content:
Blender Foundation and the online developers community are proud to present Blender 3.1, a solid update to an already outstanding release.

[previewyoutube=BCi0QRM1ADY;full][/previewyoutube]

Blender 3.1 takes a major leap in performance:

* Metal GPU backend support contributed by Apple for computers with M1 processors and AMD graphics cards
* GPU acceleration for Subdivision modifier
* Faster mesh editing
* Asset Browser indexing
* Image Editor support for large images
* Improved speed of .obj and .fbx export
* Better multi-threading, node tree evaluation and reduced memory usage in Geometry Nodes
* Plus many more performance improvements all over the board. New animation tools in the Graph Editor, new nodes for procedural modeling in Geometry Nodes, user interface improvements, Video Sequencer editor, Grease Pencil, hundreds of bug fixes and so much more.

Explore the [url=blender.org/download/releases/3-1/]release notes[/url] for an in-depth look at what’s new.

Blender wouldn’t be possible without its amazing community, and thanks to the over 2900 individuals and organizations contributing to the Blender Development Fund.

Happy Blending!

The Blender Team
March 9th, 2022

notes.title: Blender 3.0 Released!
notes.content:
Today, 3December 2021, Blender Foundation announces the release of Blender 3.0, to mark the beginning of a new era for open source 2D/3D content creation. 

[previewyoutube=QRqY_20ti9A;full][/previewyoutube]

In many ways 3D has become mainstream now. 3D technology is an undeniable part of our lives. In the coming decade it will influence how we communicate and interact with each other and the world. Every large player in the tech industry is anticipating this development. For that reason, it is too important to leave the future only to businesses and shareholder driven practices.

The Blender organization and the community of blender.org are committed to remain an independent force to ensure that old and new ways of creating 3D experiences — whether graphics, film, games or xr — are freely and openly accessible for everyone, disregarding where you come from. With Blender 3.0 we make another step into that direction, as first of the many to be released this decade.

Blender 3.0 is available as Free Software download on blender.org.

For more information:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.blender.org/download/releases/3-0/]Blender 3.0 release log[/url]
[*] [url=https://code.blender.org/2021/10/blender-3-x-roadmap/]Blender 3.x roadmap[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JZIFWEY3l6k]Every New Feature in 6 minutes[/url]
[/list]

December 2021
Ton Roosendaal, Blender Foundation.

notes.title: Blender 2.92 Official Release Available !
notes.content:
2.92 is Blender’s first major release of 2021 ! 

It was made possible with a massive amount of community involvement, including assistance from developers and contributors worldwide. 

[previewyoutube=BnXQMxr5xg8;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, there is a wealth of features and fixes. 

The big news is Geometry Nodes, a custom modifier that allows you to manipulate geometry through a node interface. Functionality will expand rapidly over the next couple of releases, but in this iteration the focus is on point scattering. 

Of course, there’s much else to celebrate, from performance and UI improvements to the new Add Primitive Tool, which allows users to create primitives interactively in a couple of clicks. 

Talking of saving clicks, there are a host of upgrades in Blender’s sculpting workspace: the grab silhouette option, the Multires Displacement Smear tool, and more besides. 

For 2D animators, Grease Pencil continues its journey to becoming a fully-fledged 2D animation package within Blender as a whole. This means lots of new possibilities, including the option to edit strokes as though they were Bézier curves. 

Similarly, Blender’s video editing capacity has been enriched, paving the way for VSE as a legitimate open source alternative for professional editors. 

To see the full list of changes implemented in 2.92, check out the [url=blender.org/download/releases/2-92/]release page[/url]. 

And again: enormous thanks to the community, and the over 5000 individuals and organizations contributing to the Development Fund.

Happy blending,
The Blender Team

Amsterdam, 25th February, 2021.

notes.title: Blender 2.80 Beta released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8564989/f5c6990bc06692af0a2c6796ed676ae69cadbb3a.png[/img]

Today the Blender Foundation releases the first 2.80-beta version. No other release of Blender has been met with so much anticipation! It's the accumulation of 3 years of time and hundreds of months of work by developers from the Blender community. A couple of useful links:

[list]

Consider joining the [url=https://fund.blender.org/]Blender Development Fund[/url] to support the project and make 2.80 the best release ever. Enjoy!

A beta version for Steam will come next month, after some initial testing. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Blender 2.78c release now available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8564989/a29742d94b83d8fdb4fb629cb98f8b8fb7919dc5.jpg[/img]

The latest update to Blender 2.78 is out! Get it now to boost your Cycles rendering performance and get rock-solid stability. Here is the massive update list!

[h1]Cycles[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multithreaded shader compilation and optimizations for emission meshes
[*] More efficient noise reduction for Branched Path Tracing
[*] Unused shader nodes are now ignored on render time
[*] Improvements to procedural textures
[*] Fireflies reduction for background textures when using MIS
[*] Different seed for subframes and different stereo views, allowing "slow-motion" effect and improved VR experience
[*] Distance culling for objects to remove objects which are too far away from the camera
[*] Better remaining time estimation
[*] Various optimizations and fixes for deformation motion blur
[*] Added time steps BVH option to speed up rendering of scenes with motion blur
[*] Hair particle settings were moved to Geometry panel of Render context
[*] Beckmann/GGX distribution with 0 roughness is now considered a singular ray
[/list]

[h1]Cycles: GPU[/h1]
[list]
[*] Use XDG folder for cache on Linux and OSX, which avoids having per-Blender version folder with all the OpenCL/CUDA kernels built.
[*] Ability to enable/disable individual GPUs as opposite to old behaviour with pre-defined combinations only. Not only this helps to some artists, but also makes it possible to have flexible benchmark scripting.
[/list]

[h1]Cycles: CPU[/h1]
[list]
[*] Use more global SSE optimizations for SSE4.1+ kernels.
[*] Multiple improvements for the latest AVX2 CPUS:
    * Optimized various math utilities (cross-products, dot-products, min-axis-selection and others).
    * Faster version of triangle intersection function.
    * Optimization of various steps in BVH traversal algorithm (including both construction and traversal).
[/list]

[h1]Cycles: OpenCL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 3D textures support for OpenCL
[*] Major render time improvements on transparent shadows
[/list]

[h1]Dependency graph[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimization of dependency graph construction time
[*] Fix missing or wrong relation links, which were causing hard-to-reproduce bone flickering in complex rigs
[*] Fix various crashes related on linked data blocks
[*] Fixes for missing animation updates
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed regression crash when adding texture node to compositor
[*] Fixed crash of inverse kinematics on 32 bit Windows platforms
[*] Improve multi-threaded usage of fluid simulation
[*] Return correct alpha for environment map in GLSL
[/list]

Check out how the [url=https://cloud.blender.org/blog/cycles-turbocharged-how-we-made-rendering-10x-faster] massive motion blur render time improvements [/url] were made possible in the latest film project at the Blender Institute

For more detailed release docs, check out [url=https://wiki.blender.org/index.php/Dev:Ref/Release_Notes/2.78/Performance_update]the wiki[/url]

notes.title: Blender 2.76b released
notes.content:
The Blender Foundation and online developer community are proud to present Blender 2.76, released in Steam on Oct 12, 2015! 

Update: bug fix release 2.76b was released on Nov 11, 2015.

Main highlights for this release:
- Initial support for Pixar's OpenSubdiv geometry subdivision technology.
- A huge view-port performance boost.
- Big file browser performance boost and arrow keys navigation support.
- Node auto-offset feature that helps organizing node layouts.
- Absolute grid snapping in the 3D view.
- Sculpting with tiled strokes.
- Text effect strips for the sequencer, supporting subtitle export

As usual, hundreds of bugs fixed and other improvements!
